goal: Rapidly generate a campaign calendar and publish-ready captions for a focused 1–2 week content push.

milestones.title: Sprint Brief
milestones.goal: Define sprint dates, theme, featured items, and posting cadence before calendar and captions.
milestones.data:
## Sprint Brief

**Sprint start date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**Sprint end date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**Sprint theme or angle:** <!-- e.g. Weekend brunch heroes -->
**Featured item(s) or category:** <!-- comma-separated -->
**Post cadence:** <!-- e.g. 2 posts/day for 5 days -->
**Platforms:** <!-- e.g. Instagram only -->
**Notes:** <!-- constraints, voice, or CTA focus -->

passCriteria.requirement: Sprint end date is specified and is on or after the start date.
Featured item(s) or a clear theme is stated.
Post cadence is noted (e.g. posts per day or per week).

milestones.title: Campaign Calendar
milestones.goal: Produce a compact multi-day or multi-week calendar for the sprint window with formats and angles.

passCriteria.requirement: Calendar covers the full sprint window from the Sprint Brief.
Each slot includes format and at least one featured menu item by name.
Each slot includes a caption angle or talking point.

milestones.title: Caption Batch
milestones.goal: Turn each calendar slot into a publish-ready caption (hook, body, CTA, hashtags).

passCriteria.requirement: Every calendar slot has a caption.
Each caption opens with a hook (first line).
